name: The Oliver Hotel
emergency: Dial 911 immediately, then let the front desk know.

wifi.notes: No password needed. Join the network and accept the terms in your browser.

checkOut.late: Late checkout is available on request, based on availability. Ask the front desk.

dining.type: New American bistro and craft cocktails
dining.location: Ground floor, next to the lobby

dining.name: Peter Kern Lounge
dining.location: Through the alleyway behind the hotel, or behind the lobby bookshelf

parking: Valet parking at the main entrance is $28 per night. There is also a city garage across the square.
fitness: Guests get complimentary access to a partner gym one block away. Pick up a pass at the front desk.
pets: Pet-friendly rooms are available on floors 2 and 3 with prior registration.
smoking: The Oliver is 100% smoke-free. A $250 recovery fee applies to violations.
